01 · Annotator guide

How to read this trajectory

This review surface translates the structured execution log into the sequence a creative professional normally evaluates: assignment, evidence, visual development, judgement, production action, verification, and handoff.

Understand the assignment

Read the client brief, brand character, source restrictions, and acceptance bar before judging the visual result.

Inspect the visual lineage

Compare each original with its baseline, revision passes, selected state, and final master. Every meaningful preserved preview is clickable.

Examine model judgement

For every major step, review the observable evidence, selected action, alternatives, tradeoffs, uncertainty, and verification result.

Score independently

Use objective and process checks as evidence, then apply professional taste to the human verifiers and K1–K6 questions.

What “reasoning” means here

The trajectory records concise, observable decision rationale: what the model noticed, what it chose, why the choice fit the brief, which alternatives it considered, and how it tested the result. It does not claim to expose private hidden chain-of-thought.

14 material decisions and 9 connector-operation events are represented. 0 failed or blocked events remain visible with their retry, fallback, or stop decisions.

Professional-review handoff

Evidence is prepared for independent expert review.

    02 · Context

    Client brief and brand system

    Client brief

    Rebuild our insurance counter-card template and produce the district run

The printer who made Aldervale Mutual's counter cards has closed. We still have the press file and need a reusable production route, not a one-time approximation of the design.

Scope
1. District insurance counter card: 14 named exports. The compliance wording, meaning the record's Disclosure Text, is reproduced without alteration. The contact information, meaning the record's Office, belongs to this producer. The complete Disclosure Text remains inside the card trim. The card carries no district line; none of the supplied records names a district.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. Set the rebuilt card in the attached brand identity's type system and colours; the old press file shows which fields the card carries, not its typefaces, type sizes or rule positions. The license line and office are set as body text. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

    Aldervale Mutual

    Audience
    Households aged 35 to 60 with modest savings, buying because they do not want to leave a burden. They trust plainness and distrust anything that reads like a sales pitch.
    Positioning
    Premiums run 45 to 180 dollars a month, drop in comparison irrelevant. A regulated mutual at a modest, accessible band, deliberately not a private wealth manager and not a discount direct response mailer.
    Personality
    Sober · Trustworthy · Plain spoken · Institutional · Steady · Respectful
    Voice
    Sober, plain and reassuring, written the way a trusted advisor speaks across a table. No exclamation, no urgency. Example line the brand would write: A whole life policy is a promise that holds its value, and the premium you start with is the premium you keep.
    Typography
    Aldervale Mutual runs four steps. Step 01, display, is the producer name in Lexend SemiBold sentence case at 20 pt on 23 pt leading with -5 tracking, sitting directly on a 1 pt Heritage Green rule that runs the full card width. Step 02, subheading, is the district line in Lexend SemiBold at 11 pt on 14 pt with +20 tracking, immediately under that rule. Step 03, body, is Miller Text Roman at 9 pt on 13 pt with tracking 0 to a maximum of 65 characters, while premiums and all figures break out into IBM Plex Sans Regular at 10 pt on 13 pt as tabular lining figures aligned in a column, never italicised, emboldened or coloured. Step 04, fine print, is the disclosure in Miller Text Roman at 6.5 pt on 9 pt with +15 tracking, sitting directly beneath the second 1 pt Heritage Green rule so the card is bracketed top and bottom in green.

    Palette

    Ink Navy#1E2A3A
    Slate#4A5560
    Document Paper#F4F2EC
    Mist Grey#C7CBC8
    Heritage Green#3C6B54

Build Priya Nandakumar as a clearly conditional photo-free proof because her named headshot is absent.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Why this choice

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Compliance prohibits a resigned producer, and an invented or reassigned portrait would misidentify Priya. The old press file supplies fields, while V7 defines new A5 trim and brand typography.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Do not use the resigned producer image.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Decision

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Use licensed open-source Lexend SemiBold and IBM Plex Sans Regular at the specified sizes. Substitute Georgia Regular for Miller Text Roman, which was not supplied as a local font. Preserve all portraits in natural colour and use no Adobe retouch or generative portrait work.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Why this choice

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The layout must be reproducible locally, and changing skin tones or inventing a missing face would create greater risk than retaining source images.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Evidence considered

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  After0 new artifacts

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  14 PDF deliverables and all audit files are packaged in the isolated run directory.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Observable decision rationaleConcise evidence and judgement, not private chain-of-thought

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Decision

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Hand off all fourteen PDFs and the reusable template as conditional outputs; do not label them Adobe-made or press-approved.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Why this choice

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Every requested file exists, while missing Priya photography and the Miller Text substitution require honest disclosure rather than fabricated compliance.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Evidence considered

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • PRODUCTION_NOTES.md
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • artifacts/DELIVERY_MANIFEST.json
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • artifacts/FILE_INTEGRITY.json

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Alternatives and tradeoffs

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Do not delay the entire pilot while waiting for a non-supplied photo; do not invent or misassign a face.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Tradeoffs: The run delivers usable review files now, but Priya and the combined print run need owner resolution before press.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Uncertainty: None recorded.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Verification

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Result: not recorded

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Confidence: high

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Stop local LAYOUT-15 work after trajectory render and validation; leave the release exception open.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Decision

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Embed the prepared print-resolution portrait crops as JPEG streams instead of PDF lossless image streams; retain the same crop, text, color and page geometry.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Why this choice

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The first combined file was 64 MB and unnecessarily slow to share; the revised file is 7.8 MB.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Evidence considered

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • No competing alternative was material to this step.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Tradeoffs: JPEG is lossy but the crop is retained at about 360 dpi with quality 93; print text remains vector.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Observable decision rationaleConcise evidence and judgement, not private chain-of-thought

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Decision

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Test a targeted Adobe edit to remove only the background Pinebrook Savings sign while preserving Miguel unchanged; reject it if identity or scene quality shifts.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Why this choice

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The competing firm name is plainly visible in the supplied portrait and is inappropriate on an Aldervale client-facing card.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Evidence considered

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • source/producer_headshot_08.jpg
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • previews/producer-card-r009.png

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Alternatives and tradeoffs

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A crop wide enough for the A5 image would still show the sign; a crop narrow enough to remove it cuts the face.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Why this choice

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Missing producer portrait: Priya Nandakumar is active but nandakumar_headshot.jpg was not supplied.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   • Typography: Miller Text Roman was not supplied as a usable local font. Georgia Regular is substituted for license, office and disclosure text. Lexend SemiBold and IBM Plex Sans Regular are retained locally with their open-source licenses.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Photo provenance: Miguel Reyes's supplied portrait included Pinebrook Savings signage. An Adobe image_instruct_edit output removed that background sign; the original, Adobe PNG, and final crop are retained for review. No replacement person or invented headshot was used.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Independent review: No auto or human benchmark verifier scores were used as a release gate, per the user's instruction.
